description: CHANGE OF USE FROM A FLAT (USE CLASS C3) TO A 3 BED 3 PERSON HMO (HOUSE IN MULTIPLEOCCUPATION (USE CLASS C4) WITH INTERNAL ALTERATIONS. ASSOCIATED CYCLE PARKING,EXTERNAL AMENITY SPACE, AND REFUSE AND RECYCLING STORAGE
decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; "><span style="line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Refuse stored</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;"> - No refuse or waste material of any description
shall be left or stored anywhere on the site other than within a building or
refuse enclosure.</span></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Reason</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;">: To safeguard the appearance of the property and the
amenities of the area and to accord with Policies D3 and D6 of the London Plan
2021and policy D12.3 of the Local Plan 2024.</span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
" arial",sans-serif"=""><o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p style="text-align: justify; "><span style="line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Cycle Parking to be implemented</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;"> - The development hereby permitted shall
not be occupied until the cycle parking shown on the plans hereby approved has
been provided and made available for use. These facilities shall be retained
for the occupants of and visitors to the development at all times.</span></span></p><p><span style="line-height: 107%;"></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><span style="line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Reason</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;">: To ensure satisfactory facilities for cycle parking
are provided and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for
Merton: policy T5 of the London Plan 2021 and policies T16.1 and T16.2 of the
Local Plan 2024.</span></span><o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; "><span style="line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">HMO - Person Limit (Sui-Generis)</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;"> -&nbsp; The property shall be solely occupied as a
3 bedroom, 3 persons House in Multiple Occupation (HMO), unless
otherwise agreed in writing with the local planning authority.</span></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="line-height: 107%;"></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><span style="line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Reason</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;"> - To accord with terms of this application, safeguard
local road and parking conditions and residential amenity of nearby occupants
and to comply with policies D4 and T5 of the London Plan 2021 and policies D12.1,
D12.3 and T16.1 of the Local Plan 2024. &nbsp;</span></span><o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
" arial",sans-serif"=""><o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p style="text-align: justify; "><span style="line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">External Lighting </span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;">- Any external lighting shall be positioned and angled
to prevent any light spillage or glare beyond the site boundary.</span></span></p><p><span style="line-height: 107%;" arial",sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:aptos;mso-fareast-theme-font:="" minor-latin;mso-ansi-language:en-gb;mso-fareast-language:en-us;mso-bidi-language:="" ar-sa"=""></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><span style="" arial",sans-serif"=""><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Reason</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;">:&nbsp; To safeguard the amenities of the area and
the occupiers of neighbouring properties and ensure compliance with the
following Development Plan policies for Merton: policies D12.1 &amp; D12.3 of
the Local Plan 2024.</span><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; "><span style="font-size: 14px;">﻿</span><span style="line-height: 107%;" arial",sans-serif"=""><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Fire Strategy</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;"> - The development shall be carried out in
accordance with the provisions of the Fire Safety Strategy prepared by&nbsp;</span></span><span style="font-size: 14px;">Dimensions</span><span style="font-size: 14px;">&nbsp;and must fully comply with The Building Regulation
2010 (as amended) unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning
Authority.</span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><u style=""><span style="font-size: 14px;">Reason</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;">: To ensure that the development incorporates the
necessary fire safety measures in accordance with the Mayor's London Plan
Policy D12.</span></p>
